topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: The expenses for operating and administering a retirement plan, such as a 401(k) or 403(b), may be passed along to its participants. This is in addition to the expenses of the underlying investments that you may hold in your plan
answer: Retirement plan fees can include charges for operating and administering the plan, and those expenses may be passed on to participants. They are separate from the fees and expenses of the investments held in the plan, such as mutual fund operating expenses. Because fees reduce the money in your portfolio that is earning a return, consider checking plan and investment disclosures to understand both kinds of costs.
